content: Chɨmbu Mungu akozomerwa
Mʉkajɨ kʉsɨɨgana imubheene kobheene ncha abhahiiri.
Na mʉkajɨ kʉbhaginihya abhagini muzinyumba zaanyu, kʉ kʉbha kʉnzɨra yiyo, abhaatʉ abhandɨ bhaginihiryɨ bhamaraika ɨnʉ bhatɨɨzɨ nebho.
Muhiitɨ bhanʉ bhabhʉhirwɨ mokebhoho, mʉbhɨ nkina mʉbhʉhirwɨ hamwɨmwɨ nabhʉ, na bhanʉ bhakʉnyaakibhwa, mʉbhɨ nkina mʉranyaakibhwa hamwɨmwɨ nabhʉ.
Ubhukwɨri bhoreenderwa kusuukwa na abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi. Umusubhɨ nʉ ʉmʉkari bhiisizɨ ni ikisimbɨ, kʉ kʉbha Mungu aratɨnɨra abhasimbɨ na bhanʉ bhakʉtaara igʉtʉ.
Mʉtabha ne eteemwa yʉ ʉkʉsɨɨga zimpirya, nawe bhibhiisɨ bhɨnʉ mʉnabhyʉ, kʉ kʉbha Mungu umwene akabhuga, “Nɨtakukutiga na nɨtakukwɨbha zee.”
Necho tʉkʉgamba tʉkarɨɨrɨ,
Muhiitɨ abhakangati bhaanyu bhanʉ bhaarɨ bhakubhiija ringʼana rya Mungu. Mwiseege igʉrʉ we eteemwa yaabhʉ chɨmbu bhaarɨ bhakwikara kuhika ɨtɨnɨrʉ, na mwɨgɨ ubhwisirirya bhwabhʉ.
Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ ni‑wuryawurya, izʉ, reero na kemerano.
Mʉtakangiriribhwa na amiija gandɨgandɨ amagini, kʉ kʉbha ɨbhɨgʉngi bhya Mungu nebhyo bhɨkʉnaja zekoro zaanyu, ɨtarɨ imigirʉ igʉrʉ wi ibhyakurya. Imigirʉ giyo gɨtakʉsakirya chʉchʉsi bhanʉ bhakugituna.
Itwɨ tʉna ahagero hukuhurukirya ikimweso hanʉ bhanʉ bhakohocha mwibhuru ryo okosengera, bhatakwisiriribhwa kurya ikimweso kɨnʉ kiri igʉrʉ waku.

Kʉrɨngʼaana ni imigirʉ ja Musa, kuhaani ʉmʉkʉrʉ ahaagega amasaahɨ gi ibhityɨnyi na kuja nagʉ Aharɨndu ha Aharɨndu, korereke agahuruchɨ ikimweso chu ukuruushaho ʉbhʉbhɨ. Nawe zɨnyama zi ibhityɨnyi bhiyo zɨhaagegwa na kwochwa igʉtʉ wʉ ʉbhʉraarʉ.
Igʉrʉ wa rɨnʉ, Yɨɨsu wʉʉsi akanyaakibhwa na kukwa igʉtʉ wʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu, korereke abhɨngukyɨ abhaatʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwabhʉ kʉhɨtɨra amasaahɨ gaazɨ.
Mmbe na niitwɨ tumutunɨ igʉtʉ wʉ ʉbhʉraarʉ na kogega zɨsʉni chɨmbu ewe aagɨgirɨ.
Tokorebhu kʉ kʉbha mʉʉsɨ tʉtaana rʉbhɨri rʉnʉ rʉkʉrama kemerano, nawe turiisega kusikɨra mʉrʉbhɨri rʉnʉ rukuuza.
Mmbe, kʉhɨtɨra kwa Yɨɨsu tʉkajɨ kukumya Mungu, kʉ kʉbha amangʼana gɨɨtʉ gu ukukumya iriina ryazɨ ni‑chɨmbu ikimweso kɨnʉ tukuhurucha kuminywa gɨnʉ gikwisirirya.
Mʉtɨɨbha kokora amazʉmu na kwisakirya, kʉ kʉbha kokorabhu, necho ikimweso kɨnʉ kekozomera Mungu.

Mwigwɨ abhakangati bhaanyu na kutuna ganʉ bhakʉbhaswaja, kʉ kʉbha ebho nebho bhakotengeeza igʉrʉ wa zekoro zaanyu na bhareenderwa kʉgamba emeremo jabhʉ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu. Mubhiigwɨ, korereke bhakore emeremo jabhʉ kwa bhozomerwa, ɨtabha kwa kurumɨka, ne emeremo jabhʉ giyo gɨtakʉbha na bhwera bhwʉbhwʉsi kwa niimwɨ.
Mʉtʉsabhɨrɨ, kʉ kʉbha amaheene zekoro zɨɨtʉ nɨ‑nzʉmu, na toreenda kokora ge eheene kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi.
Nɨrabhiisasaama bhʉkʉngʼu mʉbhɨ mʉransabhɨra, korereke nɨgarʉkɨ kwa niimwɨ bhwangʉ.
Amangʼana gɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ
Mungu wo omorembe akamuryʉra Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wɨɨtʉ Yɨɨsu, Umuriisha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wa zɨngʼʉndu, kʉ kʉbha akiitɨra amasaahɨ gaazɨ ganʉ gakwerekanʼya ʉbhʉragɨ bhwa kemerano.
Mungu abhahɨ amanaga go okokora ubhwɨndi bhwazɨ. Na akore mozekoro zɨɨtʉ ganʉ gakomozomera kʉnzɨra ya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ. Ewe agungibhwɨ kemerano! Garamɨ.
Nɨrabhiisasaama abhahiiri bhaanɨ, mwitegeerere bhwaheene amangʼana gʉ ʉkʉbhatongera ganʉ nɨbhaandikiirɨ mʉnyarʉbha inguhɨ yɨnʉ.
Nereenda momenye umwisirirya ʉmʉkɨndichɨtʉ Timoseo atigurukiirwɨ kurwa mokebhoho. Arɨɨbhɨ araangʉha kuuza, nɨraaza nawe kwa kʉbhataarɨra.
Mʉbhakeerye abhakangati bhaanyu bhʉʉsi na abharɨndu bha Mungu bhʉʉsi. Abharɨndu bha Mungu bha Itaariya bharabhakeerya.
Ɨbhɨgʉngi bhɨbhɨ na niimwɨ imwʉsi.
